<b>Ragpelt</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
25 Ragpelt are required to complete the <i>[[Crawbug Clearing]]</i> [[wish]], given by [[Creige]] in [[Halfway Home]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot_SS_Creige_01.png!Creige location in [[Greymoor]]
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Creige 01.png!Creige in Greymoor
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Ragpelt is dropped by [[Craw]]s, [[Tallcraw]]s and [[Squatcraw]]s in [[Greymoor]] during the <i>Crawbug Clearing</i> wish, drifting down slowly after those enemies are defeated. Craws drop 1 each, and both Tallcraws and Squatcraws drop 2-5 each. Ragpelts will still drop from enemies killed in the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)|enemy gauntlet]] in Craw Lake.

[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can carry up to 25 Ragpelt, after which they will no longer drop from defeated Craw enemies.
